using System.Net;

namespace Jellyfin.Api.Networking;

/// <summary>
/// Defines the <see cref="INetworkManager"/> interface.
/// </summary>
public interface INetworkManager
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether the server is configured to allow remote access.
    /// </summary>
    bool IsRemoteAccessAllowed { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether the server is configured to allow remote access from the internet.
    /// </summary>
    bool IsRemoteAccessAllowedFromInternet { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Gets a value indicating whether the server is configured to allow remote access from local networks.
    /// </summary>
    bool IsRemoteAccessAllowedFromLocalNetworks { get; }

    /// <summary>
    /// Determines whether the server should allow access from the specified IP address.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="ipAddress">The IP address to check.</param>
    /// <returns>A <see cref="RemoteAccessPolicyResult"/> indicating whether access is allowed.</returns>
    RemoteAccessPolicyResult ShouldAllowServerAccess(IPAddress ipAddress);
}

using Jellyfin.Api.Middleware;
using Jellyfin.Api.Networking;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using System.Net;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Xunit;

namespace Jellyfin.Api.Tests.Middleware;

public class IPBasedAccessValidationMiddlewareTests
{
    [Fact]
    public async Task Invoke_LogsWarning_WhenRemoteAccessIsNotAllowed()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<IPBasedAccessValidationMiddleware>>();
        var networkManagerMock = new Mock<INetworkManager>();
        networkManagerMock.Setup(n => n.ShouldAllowServerAccess(It.IsAny<IPAddress>()))
            .Returns(RemoteAccessPolicyResult.Deny);
        var httpContextMock = new Mock<HttpContext>();
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.IsLocal()).Returns(false);
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.GetNormalizedRemoteIP()).Returns(IPAddress.Parse("192.168.1.100"));
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.Request.Path).Returns("/path/to/resource");

        var middleware = new IPBasedAccessValidationMiddleware((httpContext) => Task.CompletedTask, loggerMock.Object);

        // Act
        await middleware.Invoke(httpContextMock.Object, networkManagerMock.Object).ConfigureAwait(false);

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogWarning(
            "Blocking request to {Path} by {RemoteIP} due to IP filtering rule, reason: {Reason}",
            It.IsAny<string>(),
            It.IsAny<string>(),
            It.IsAny<RemoteAccessPolicyResult>()), Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]
    public async Task Invoke_AllowsAccess_WhenRemoteAccessIsAllowed()
    {
        // Arrange
        var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger<IPBasedAccessValidationMiddleware>>();
        var networkManagerMock = new Mock<INetworkManager>();
        networkManagerMock.Setup(n => n.ShouldAllowServerAccess(It.IsAny<IPAddress>()))
            .Returns(RemoteAccessPolicyResult.Allow);
        var httpContextMock = new Mock<HttpContext>();
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.IsLocal()).Returns(false);
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.GetNormalizedRemoteIP()).Returns(IPAddress.Parse("192.168.1.100"));
        httpContextMock.Setup(c => c.Request.Path).Returns("/path/to/resource");

        var middleware = new IPBasedAccessValidationMiddleware((httpContext) => Task.CompletedTask, loggerMock.Object);

        // Act
        await middleware.Invoke(httpContextMock.Object, networkManagerMock.Object).ConfigureAwait(false);

        // Assert
        loggerMock.Verify(l => l.LogWarning(It.IsAny<string>(), It.IsAny<object[]>()), Times.Never);
    }
}
